evals.prompt: Our checkout flow crashes maybe 1 in 10 times when a user applies a coupon. We've tried reading the code and added a null check last week but it still happens. We're on a Node.js/Express backend with a React frontend.
evals.expected_output: Agent sets an explicit goal, gathers facts before reading code, generates 2-4 specific falsifiable hypotheses, designs targeted [DEBUG-HUNT]-tagged instrumentation for each hypothesis, and explicitly waits for runtime reproduction data before proposing any fix.

evals.prompt: The user avatar isn't loading on profile pages for accounts created before 2024. I tried fixing the URL builder in avatar.service.ts last week but it's still broken for legacy accounts.
evals.expected_output: Agent recognizes that a previous static fix failed (the classic debug-mode trigger), refuses to guess at another patch, sets a goal, designs instrumentation to prove where the URL is going wrong at runtime, and waits for evidence before proposing a new fix.

evals.prompt: The dashboard takes 8 seconds to load since last Thursday's deploy. The query looks fine to me when I read it. Users are complaining.
evals.expected_output: Agent sets a goal, offers smoke-test as an exploration option (since this is a performance issue visible in a running instance), generates timing-focused hypotheses (N+1 query, missing index, cache eviction, new code path), designs instrumentation with timestamps to isolate the slow segment.
